install: Set up pages, blocks and Journal
notConfigured: The agency has not set up pages and collections yet.
error: We could not confirm this change. Your draft is still here.
paused: The agency has paused pages and Journal changes.
emptySlots: Select a container on the canvas to allow customer blocks there.
title: Title
draftConflict: Access or approval changed while this entry was open. Your draft is kept here.
discardQuestion: Discard the changes in this entry?
readyHelp: Ready entries are included when someone publishes the site. Draft edits keep the previous live version.
archiveHelp: Archiving removes the entry in the next site publication.
savedFirst: Save or discard your changes before archiving.
reloadRequired: The change is saved. Close this panel and load the saved version to continue.
storageFailed: This browser could not keep your last edit, so it was not applied. Download your draft before closing.
recoverySaved: Closing Journal keeps this draft in your browser.
discardRecoveriesQuestion: Discard all saved Journal draft copies for this site? Download them first if you want to keep a backup.
importedUnavailable: Pages and blocks are not available for this site yet.
importedSetupHelp: Approve the prepared page template with one content area and up to 10 text sections. Customers can edit the marked text on pages they create.
importedNotConfigured: The agency has not approved page templates for this site yet.
importedReapproveHelp: Reapproving lets customers add pages from the saved template and edit marked text on every generated page.
importedPaused: Page and block changes need a current agency approval. Existing pages remain on the site.
importedNavigationHelp: New pages get their own address. They are not added to the site menu automatically.
importedNoPages: Add a page to start adding text sections.
importedPageLimit: This template has reached its page limit.
importedBlockLimit: This area has reached its section limit.
importedWait: Finish saving or load the saved version before changing pages and blocks.
importedReloadRequired: Load the saved version before editing again.
